motivation.positive_evidence: The exact SOL completed-hour 10/30 SMA-cross route remained positive across three historical partitions and 20 bp round-trip stress, though its last partition depended on the largest winner.
motivation.negative_evidence: The 4h UT family overtraded or exited too early under 14 to 20 bp round-trip costs.
motivation.testable_change: Use one slower completed-4h 10/30 SMA trend state with a volatility-scaled structural stop, no fixed target, and fixed equity-risk sizing.

chronology.opening_rule: Open development first; do not retune or open later partitions if aggregate stress or largest-winner criteria fail.

support_criteria: independent-asset aggregate nominal and stress net PnL and profit factor exceed zero and one
independent-asset aggregate nominal and stress net remain positive after the largest winner is removed
no-lookahead, append-invariance, gap reset, fixed-risk sizing, and timing tests pass
asset-specific unsupported sides remain visible but fail closed
shared-account concurrency simulation passes before live authority
falsifiers: aggregate development nominal or stress expectancy is non-positive
aggregate development depends on the largest winner
a future bar changes a prior entry, stop, size, or exit
any completed-4h decision is executed before its close
parameters are changed after viewing V73 returns
